body.title: Server rules
body.description: Rules for everyone playing on the server.

props.title: Server rules
props.body:
1. Be respectful. No harassment, hate speech or spam.
2. No cheating, hacked clients, x-ray or duplication glitches.
3. No griefing or stealing outside of PvP areas.
4. Keep chat in English in public channels.
5. Do not advertise other servers.
6. Staff decisions are final. Appeals go through a ticket.

Breaking the rules can lead to a mute, kick or ban without a refund of purchased perks.

body.title: Store terms
body.description: What you get when you buy from the store.

props.title: Store terms
props.body:
Purchases are virtual perks for this Minecraft server and have no cash value. They are linked to the username you enter at checkout, so check it before you pay.

Ranks stay on your account for as long as the server runs them. Monthly subscriptions renew until you cancel in your account. If you are banned for breaking the server rules, purchased perks are not refunded.

This server is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mojang or Microsoft.

Questions? Open a support ticket and we will help.

body.title: Refund policy
body.description: When and how you can get your money back.

props.title: Refund policy
props.body:
Store items are digital and are delivered to your Minecraft username straight after payment, so purchases are final once they have been delivered.

We refund a purchase in full when it could not be delivered and our team cannot fix the delivery within 72 hours, or when you were charged twice for the same order. Open a support ticket with your order number and we will look at it within two working days.

Monthly packages can be cancelled at any time in your account. You keep the perks until the end of the period you already paid for, and you are not charged again.

If you open a chargeback or payment dispute instead of contacting us, the items of that order are removed and the account may be blocked from the store.

body.title: Privacy policy
body.description: What data the store keeps and why.

props.title: Privacy policy
props.body:
To deliver your purchases we store your email address, your Minecraft username and your order history. Payments are handled by our payment provider; we never see or store your full card details.

We use this data only to run the store: to deliver items, send receipts, answer support tickets and prevent fraud. We do not sell it or share it with anyone else, except when the law requires it.

Order records are kept for as long as accounting law requires. You can ask for a copy of your data, or for your account to be deleted, by opening a support ticket.

The store uses only the cookies it needs to keep you signed in and to remember your basket.
